product.title: Silver Springs Clear Kayak Tour – Manatees & Monkeys Tour

description.text: Discover a side of Florida away from the theme parks–and enjoy a more active experience than on many other tours–on this stand-up paddleboard (SUP) and kayak adventure for beginners and experts alike, complete with wildlife spotting. Start with a lesson and hear facts about the local ecosystem before heading into the clear waters of a natural spring to spot monkeys, manatees, otters, turtles, and more.Go beyond sightseeing and kayak or paddleboard in a Florida natural spring Discover a unique ecosystem of monkeys, manatees, and other species Learn new skills–or sharpen existing ones–during an Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
